root_cause: EvidenceLevel is an int type (EvidenceLevel int) in internal/domain/scoring.go with no MarshalJSON method. Go's default JSON encoder serializes it as a number (0/1/2) instead of a string ("unknown"/"unverified"/"confirmed"). The Hugo template in web/layouts/partials/home-story.html uses $story.evidenceLevel directly, producing CSS class story-evidence-0 (or 1 or 2) instead of story-evidence-confirmed.
fix_approach: Add MarshalJSON() to EvidenceLevel that returns []byte(json.Marshal(e.String())). Add UnmarshalJSON() that parses JSON string and maps to the correct const.

data_flow.step1: cmd/export/main.go calls RunSnapshot() → builds domain.Snapshot with EvidenceLevel const values (EvidenceConfirmed = 2, EvidenceUnverified = 1, EvidenceUnknown = 0)
data_flow.step2: hugo.DataPublisher publishes domain.Snapshot to web/data/homepage.json → JSON marshal converts EvidenceLevel to number (2) instead of string ("confirmed")
data_flow.step3: Hugo site build reads homepage.json → $story.evidenceLevel is number 2 in Hugo context
data_flow.step4: web/layouts/partials/home-story.html renders class="story-evidence-story-evidence-2" instead of class="story-evidence-confirmed"
data_flow.step5: scripts/site-test.sh greps for story-evidence-confirmed in built HTML → FAIL: HS-015 evidence badge check fails
data_flow.step6: Refresh news workflow build job fails → no Pages artifact uploaded → deploy job skipped → live site still shows Jekyll README

related_fields.impact: web/layouts/feeds/single.html uses .status directly → renders number instead of status name (0/1/2/3/4 vs healthy/no-updates/failed/disabled/not-checked). Affects AC3 (feeds page).
Used in web/data/heartbeat.json. If heartbeat is rendered in Hugo templates, would show number instead of string (ok/partial/failed).

related_fields.impact: Serializes as nanoseconds (int) not human-readable string. Feeds page shows e.g. 123000000 instead of 123ms.
related_fields.note: Different type than custom int aliases; Duration has no JSON marshal override in stdlib

verification_method: Run: go build ./cmd/export && HSC_ENV=test HSC_STORAGE_BACKEND=sqlite HSC_STORAGE_PATH=/tmp/test-db HSC_DATA_DIR=/tmp/test-data HSC_HUGO_BASE_URL=http://localhost ./dist/export — then inspect the evidenceLevel field in web/data/homepage.json. After fix, it should be a string value like "confirmed" not a number.
